name: White Tiger

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fear: Unblockable yetenek doğruluğunu sabit %100 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok Şansını kaldırır.

signatureAbility:
The Darkness Outside The Cave
At the start of each fight, inflict a Fear Passive reducing Unblockable Ability Accuracy by a flat 100% and removing Perfect Block Chance for [6 - 20] seconds.
Once per fight when either Champion drops to 15% of their Max Health, White Tiger gains a Power Gain Buff granting 100% of her Max Power over [20 - 6] seconds. As a Defender, this only triggers once per Quest.
immunityDetails:
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı 🔮
• %20 Arındırma (rakipteki her Buff için) 💪🏼

abilitySections.title: Power of a God
content: The might of the Tiger God grants White Tiger Immunity to Nullify.
White Tiger has -70% Offensive Combat Power Rate, but she Passively gains Power equal to 50% of the Power the Opponent gains.

abilitySections.title: Strength of a Fighter
content: When inflicted with a Damaging Debuff, White Tiger has a 20% chance for each Buff on the Opponent to Purify it.
Dashing forwards grants a non-stacking Precision Passive increasing Critical Rating by +[4,125] for 2 seconds, paused during White Tiger's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Combo-Ending Attacks - Nullify
content: Combo-Ending Attacks Nullify a Power Gain or Energize Buff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: On activation, gain a Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by +[3,695.7] for 20 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 5.

For each personal Fury Buff, each hit Power Steals 1% of the Opponent's current Power, and White Tiger gains 200% of the Power Stolen. After triggering, this effect goes on cooldown until the end of White Tiger's next Special Attack.
Finishing a Special Attack with at least 1 Bar of Power grants an Unblockable Passive for 1.5 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This Special Attack grants White Tiger 1 additional Fury Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a Bleed Debuff dealing [24,638] Direct Damage over 3 seconds, paused while the Opponent is Indestructible.
While this Bleed is active, the Opponent cannot heal and the healing denied is transferred to White Tiger, up to 5% of her Max Health per second.
After this Bleed expires, Nullify all Regeneration Buffs on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: As an Attacker, this Special Attack cannot be activated unless White Tiger is charging or performing a Heavy Attack.
This Special Attack grants White Tiger 2 additional Fury Buffs. These can exceed the stack limit.
Inflict a Fear Debuff for 40 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Darkness Outside The Cave
content: At the start of each fight, inflict a Fear Passive reducing Unblockable Ability Accuracy by a flat 100% and removing Perfect Block Chance for [6 - 20] seconds.

Once per fight when either Champion drops to 15% of their Max Health, White Tiger gains a Power Gain Buff granting 100% of her Max Power over [20 - 6] seconds. As a Defender, this only triggers once per Quest.
